mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(i.id) FROM orders_normal_orders_items i INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.company_id = o.company_id

SELECT i.id AS itemRowId, i.order_id AS orderId, i.item_id AS itemId, i.item_name AS itemName, i.item_bn AS itemBn, i.price AS price, i.cost_price AS costPrice, i.num AS num, i.item_fee AS itemFee, i.commission_fee AS commissionFee, i.cost_fee AS costFee, i.point_fee AS itemPointFee, i.total_fee AS itemTotalFee, i.member_discount AS memberDiscount, i.coupon_discount AS couponDiscount, i.discount_fee AS itemDiscountFee, i.discount_info AS discountInfo, i.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, i.delivery_time AS itemDeliveryTime, i.delivery_code AS itemDeliveryCode, i.delivery_corp AS itemDeliveryCorp, i.aftersales_status AS aftersalesStatus, i.item_spec_desc AS itemSpecDesc, i.supplier_id AS itemSupplierId, o.mobile AS mobile, o.user_id AS userId, o.create_time AS orderCreateTime, o.total_fee AS orderTotalFee, o.freight_fee AS orderFreightFee, o.distributor_id AS distributorId, o.order_class AS orderClass, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.pay_type AS payType, o.pay_status AS payStatus, o.receipt_type AS receiptType, o.ziti_status AS zitiStatus, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_mobile AS receiverMobile, o.receiver_zip AS receiverZip, o.receiver_state AS receiverState, o.receiver_city AS receiverCity, o.receiver_district AS receiverDistrict, o.receiver_address AS receiverAddress, o.remark AS remark, o.end_time AS endTime, o.delivery_status AS orderDeliveryStatus, o.delivery_time AS orderDeliveryTime, o.delivery_corp AS orderDeliveryCorp, o.delivery_code AS orderDeliveryCode, o.cancel_status AS cancelStatus, o.prescription_status AS prescriptionStatus FROM orders_normal_orders_items i INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.company_id = o.company_id
ORDER BY o.distributor_id DESC, o.order_id DESC, o.create_time ASC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_normal_orders o LEFT JOIN offline_payment of ON o.order_id = of.order_id WHERE CAST(o.auto_cancel_time AS UNSIGNED) < #{threshold} AND o.order_status = 'NOTPAY' AND o.order_class IN ('normal', 'shopguide', 'employee_purchase') AND o.pay_type = 'offline_pay' AND (of.check_status IS NULL OR of.check_status != 0)

SELECT o.* FROM orders_normal_orders o LEFT JOIN offline_payment of ON o.order_id = of.order_id WHERE CAST(o.auto_cancel_time AS UNSIGNED) < #{threshold} AND o.order_status = 'NOTPAY' AND o.order_class IN ('normal', 'shopguide', 'employee_purchase') AND o.pay_type = 'offline_pay' AND (of.check_status IS NULL OR of.check_status != 0) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_normal_orders o WHERE CAST(o.auto_finish_time AS UNSIGNED) < #{finishBeforeSec} AND o.order_status = 'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM' AND o.delivery_status = 'DONE' AND o.cancel_status IN ('NO_APPLY_CANCEL', 'FAILS') AND o.order_class IN ('normal', 'seckill', 'groups', 'shopguide', 'employee_purchase') AND (o.receipt_type IS NULL OR o.receipt_type != 'dada')

SELECT o.* FROM orders_normal_orders o WHERE CAST(o.auto_finish_time AS UNSIGNED) < #{finishBeforeSec} AND o.order_status = 'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM' AND o.delivery_status = 'DONE' AND o.cancel_status IN ('NO_APPLY_CANCEL', 'FAILS') AND o.order_class IN ('normal', 'seckill', 'groups', 'shopguide', 'employee_purchase') AND (o.receipt_type IS NULL OR o.receipt_type != 'dada') ORDER BY o.order_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT user_id AS user_id, SUM(CAST(total_fee AS SIGNED)) AS fee FROM orders_normal_orders WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY user_id
